development.//: Dev client: needs the `expo-dev-client` package and (optionally) an Expo account. NOT required for a plain local debug APK.

preview.//: Free-plan friendly: an installable APK, distributed by link/file — no Google Play, no paid Expo plan needed.

local.//: Runs the whole Android build on this machine: `eas build -p android --profile local --local`. Requires JDK 17 + Android SDK. No Expo account is charged for a local build.

production.//: Release APK for sideloading. Signing is either the locally generated keystore (see README) or EAS-managed credentials.
Intentionally empty: this app is sideloaded. Google Play submission is out of scope for the offline-first spec.
